scripts.postinstall: if [[ -x "$(command -v husky)" ]]; then husky install; fi
scripts.sbom: rm -rf _artifacts/sbom && mkdir -p _artifacts/sbom && cdxgen --type js --format cyclonedx --json-pretty --exclude 'docs/**' --exclude 'examples/**' --output _artifacts/sbom/sbom.cyclonedx.json && cdxgen --type js --format spdx --json-pretty --exclude 'docs/**' --exclude 'examples/**' --output _artifacts/sbom/sbom.spdx.json
